text: The 739m-tall **Monte Titano** dominates the surrounding landscape and is visible from almost every point in the Republic.
NOTE: Look for the **three towers** to safely identify it.
text_zh: 高達 739 公尺的**蒂塔諾山**主導了周圍的景觀，在共和國的幾乎每個角落都清晰可見。
注意：尋找**三座塔**來確實辨識它。

text: The landscape of San Marino largely consists of smooth **agricultural hills**, with many small winding roads. The vegetation is distinctly **Mediterranean**, and normally appears quite lush.
text_zh: 聖馬利諾的景觀大多由平緩的**農田山丘**組成，有許多小型蜿蜒道路。植被具有明顯的**地中海**特色，通常看起來相當茂盛。

text: Sammarinese licence plates are **short**, **white** and have **blue lettering** on them.
NOTE: Other European countries will typically have **longer** licence plates, often with one or more **blue strips**.
text_zh: 聖馬利諾車牌很**短**、呈**白色**，上面有**藍色字體**。
注意：其他歐洲國家的車牌通常較**長**，且通常帶有一個或多個**藍色條紋**。

text: Road signs and bollards are **generally identical** to the ones used in Italy.
NOTE: Many road signs give directions to the nearby Italian city of **Rimini**.
text_zh: 道路標誌與路樁**大致與**義大利使用的相同。
注意：許多道路標誌會指引通往鄰近的義大利城市**里米尼**。

text: Just like Italy, most utility poles in San Marino are **round **and made** **of **concrete. **Wooden poles are also found in the country.
text_zh: 就像義大利一樣，聖馬利諾的大多數電線桿都是**圓**的且由**混凝土****製成**。該國也能見到木製電線桿。

text: San Marino is the only country in the world to use **yellow **chevrons with **burgundy red **arrows.
text_zh: 聖馬利諾是世界上唯一使用**黃色**轉彎標誌搭配**酒紅色**箭頭的國家。

text: These **elaborate pedestrian crossings**, with painted blue crosswalks and hanging signs, are specific to San Marino.
text_zh: 這些**精緻的人行穿越道**（繪有藍色斑馬線並懸掛標誌）是聖馬利諾特有的。

text: **Lime-green bins** are particularly common in San Marino. In Generation 4 coverage some of them have been replaced by **black **bins.
text_zh: **萊姆綠色垃圾桶**在聖馬利諾特別常見。在第四代街景覆蓋中，其中一些已被替換為**黑色**垃圾桶。

text: The Superstrada di San Marino runs from the border village of Dogana to the City of San Marino. It is the **only divided road** in the country, and the lanes are separated by a **metal guardrail**.
text_zh: 聖馬利諾快速公路從邊境村莊多加納延伸至聖馬利諾市。它是該國**唯一的雙向分向道路**，車道由**金屬護欄**分隔。

text: The **historic centre** is covered by a Generation 3 trekker camera.
text_zh: **歷史中心**由第三代徒步拍攝相機所覆蓋。
